summary.title: The Code on Social Security, 2020
summary.primary_objective: Amends and consolidates the laws relating to social security with the goal to extend social security to all employees and workers in the organized, unorganized, and gig/platform sectors.
repealed_acts: The Employees' Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952
The Building and Other Construction Workers' Welfare Cess Act, 1996
The Unorganised Workers' Social Security Act, 2008

sections.title: Schemes and Applicability of Provident Fund
sections.statutory_text: The Central Government may frame the Employees' Provident Fund Scheme for establishing a provident fund for employees. The provisions of this Chapter shall apply to every establishment in which twenty or more persons are employed (as specified in the First Schedule). Employer contribution (12%) and employee contribution (12%) must be deposited by the 15th of the following calendar month.

penalties.first_offense_fine: Fine up to ₹1,00,000 or imprisonment up to 1 to 3 years
penalties.subsequent_offense: Imprisonment up to 3 years and fine of ₹2,00,000

sections.citation: The Code on Social Security, 2020, Sec. 16

sections.title: All Employees to be Insured and ESIC Applicability
sections.statutory_text: Every establishment employing ten or more persons (other than seasonal factories) where wage ceiling does not exceed statutory wage ceiling (currently ₹21,000 per month) shall be covered under ESIC. Contributions comprise 3.25% by employer and 0.75% by employee, granting medical, sickness, and disability benefits.

thresholds.criterion: Establishment headcount and employee wage ceiling
thresholds.applicability_limit: 10 or more employees earning up to ₹21,000/month

penalties.first_offense_fine: Fine up to ₹50,000 or imprisonment up to 1 year
penalties.subsequent_offense: Imprisonment up to 2 years and fine up to ₹1,00,000

sections.citation: The Code on Social Security, 2020, Sec. 32

sections.title: Payment of Gratuity
sections.statutory_text: Gratuity shall be payable to an employee on the termination of his employment after he has rendered continuous service for not less than five years: Provided that the completion of continuous service of five years shall not be necessary where termination is due to death, disablement, or expiry of fixed-term employment (pro-rata gratuity eligible on completion of 1 year). Gratuity is calculated at 15 days wages per year of service, capped at ₹20,00,000.

thresholds.enforcing_authority: Controlling Authority under Payment of Gratuity

penalties.first_offense_fine: Fine up to ₹50,000 or imprisonment up to 6 months to 1 year

sections.citation: The Code on Social Security, 2020, Sec. 53

sections.title: Right to Payment of Maternity Benefit
sections.statutory_text: Every woman shall be entitled to the payment of maternity benefit at the rate of the average daily wage for the period of her actual absence up to a maximum of twenty-six weeks of which not more than eight weeks shall precede the expected delivery date, provided she has worked in the establishment for not less than eighty days in the twelve months preceding delivery.

thresholds.criterion: Woman worker with 80 days attendance in preceding 12 months

penalties.first_offense_fine: Fine up to ₹50,000 or imprisonment up to 6 months
penalties.subsequent_offense: Imprisonment up to 1 year and fine up to ₹1,00,000

sections.citation: The Code on Social Security, 2020, Sec. 60
